body.name: Calendar-block full-covariance interval
body.construction: Fix \(\alpha_{\mathrm{st}}=\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}=\alpha/2\). Use complete retained blocks \(J_k=\{(k-1)(a_T+b_T)+1,\ldots,(k-1)(a_T+b_T)+b_T\}\) for \(k=1,\ldots,K_T\), with \(a_T=\lceil3\log(T\vee2)/|\log\rho_0|\rceil\), \(b_T=\max\{1,\lfloor T^{1/2}\rfloor\}\), and the following \(a_T\) observations discarded after each retained block. Split retained blocks by odd and even \(k\); for each block form \(\Psi_k\) using a fit trained on the opposite parity and the actual selected local-polynomial weights \(w_{st}\). For \(K_T\ge2\), set \(\widehat V_{\mathrm{cal}}=K_T(K_T-1)^{-1}\sum_k(\Psi_k-\overline\Psi)^2\), and add \(\sum_s\pi_s^2\widehat V_{B,s}/n_s\) to obtain \(\widehat{\operatorname{se}}^2\). For \(N\ge2\), use the full donor sample covariance and spectrally clip its eigenvalues to \([c_\Sigma/2,2C_\Sigma]\); for \(N=1\), clip \(I_{Sd}\) and invoke the full-range convention below. With \(q_{\mathrm{don}}=\sqrt{Sd/\alpha_{\mathrm{don}}}\), use the \(\widehat\Sigma\)-ellipsoid of radius \(q_{\mathrm{don}}/\sqrt N\), set \(R_\alpha=z_{\mathrm{crit}}\widehat{\operatorname{se}}+C_H\sum_s\pi_s\widehat h_s^\lambda+C_H(q_{\mathrm{don}}/\sqrt N)^\kappa\), and define \(C_\alpha=[\widehat\tau-R_\alpha,\widehat\tau+R_\alpha]\cap[-2B,2B]\). All block, parity, grid, and equality tie-breaking rules are deterministic. If fewer than two retained blocks have finite non-bookkeeping scores, \(N<2\), some \(n_s<2\), an opposite-parity training fold is empty, any denominator is undefined, any numerical input is nonfinite, or \(\mathsf F_{\mathrm{fb}}\) occurs, define \(C_\alpha=[-2B,2B]\).
